Maintain Multiple Copies of Computations.anchor: A cache read/write: an @cached decorator (aiocache), a .get()/.set() call on a cache object, or functools.lru_cache.
Maintain Multiple Copies of Computations.discriminator: The cache is consulted before the expensive computation (get-or-compute pattern). PRESENT = a cache lookup gates the computation; WEAK = cache instantiated/imported but never read on the path; ABSENT = no cache at all.

Introduce Concurrency.anchor: An async def handler, or a worker/pool configuration (workers=, ThreadPoolExecutor, asyncio.gather).
Introduce Concurrency.discriminator: Concurrency is real: an async function that awaits actual I/O, or workers > 1. WEAK = async def whose body contains a blocking call (time.sleep, sync DB) and thus serializes despite being async; ABSENT = no async and no worker pool.

Bound Queue Sizes.anchor: A Queue(...) construction (asyncio.Queue, queue.Queue, or similar).
Bound Queue Sizes.discriminator: A maxsize keyword present and set to a positive integer literal. PRESENT = maxsize=N with N>0; ABSENT = maxsize=0 or omitted (unbounded); WEAK = maxsize=<variable/expr> that cannot be resolved statically.

Degradation.anchor: A conditional branch that returns or raises 503 (a service-unavailable / shed path).
Degradation.discriminator: The 503 is gated on a degradation or health condition (e.g. if should_degrade / load flag). PRESENT = conditional shed on a real flag; WEAK = a 503 path exists but is ungated/unconditional; ABSENT = no 503 path.

Ping/Echo.anchor: A health/liveness route or a ping call.
Ping/Echo.discriminator: It probes a real check and returns status accordingly. PRESENT = status derived from an actual check; WEAK = a bare return "ok" with no underlying probe; ABSENT = no health/ping endpoint.

Retry.anchor: A @retry decorator (tenacity) or an explicit retry loop.
Retry.discriminator: Has a stop condition (stop_after_attempt / max retries) so it will not loop forever, and wraps the failing I/O call. PRESENT = retry with stop condition around the I/O; WEAK = bare @retry with no stop condition; ABSENT = no retry mechanism.

State Resynchronization.anchor: A read of persisted/WAL state that runs at startup.
State Resynchronization.discriminator: The persisted-state read is wired into a startup path AND feeds recovery (re-enqueue / restore). PRESENT = replay reads persisted state and is invoked on startup; WEAK = a replay function exists but is never called at boot, or state is only written and never read back; ABSENT = no persisted-state read.
